headline: MIA @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.93 at WSN 5.24, with a projected total of 9.16. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: MIA moved +0.35 runs while WSN moved +1.60, changing the projected margin by -1.25 runs. The projected total climbed +1.95, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Lake Bachar has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Xavier Edwards, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Andrés Chaparro, Connor Norby because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
